cases.rationale: Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. Several actual passenger cars are visible on the road. The foreground directional ONLY sign and the small rectangular traffic instruction sign are not identifiable stop signs; the curved street-lamp structures are not traffic signals. Palms and ground vegetation have no plant-pot context. No other listed object is identifiable, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The large woolly animal at left is an actual sheep, with its fleece and sheep face visible. The short-haired black-and-white animal lying at right is an actual dog. Its collar is not a tie. The grass, trees and fence supply no further listed objects. No unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. A leather baseball fielding glove surrounds the baseball; its pocket, webbing and lacing identify a mitt rather than an ordinary hand glove. The wooden bat and baseball are not among the 75 categories. The red supporting surface does not establish furniture or an eating table. No other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is present.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The pink sofa and white single armchair establish couch and chair separately. Bound books stand on the shelves; a button-covered remote lies in the lower-left foreground. The tray holds recognizable small tea cups beside a teapot. Both flower arrangements have vase bodies and cut-flower context, rather than plants growing in pots or bottles. The low table supports tea service but is also a living-room coffee table; whether it meets the frozen dining/eating-table definition remains unclear (60). Small scattered paper and packaging do not establish further listed objects.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The large leather carry bag has handles and a soft shoulder/carry-bag form, supporting handbag rather than rigid suitcase or backpack. Bound books are visible along the upper edge. The partly cropped white handset at the bottom has a small display and keypad, supporting cell phone; the separate dark click-wheel music player is not a phone or remote. The hairbrush is not a toothbrush. The slim horizontal metallic implement below the books could be a small blade/letter-opener or a non-knife grooming implement, so knife (43) remains unclear. Pens, toiletries, wallet, cables and other small accessories do not establish the other listed categories.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. A standing human silhouette is visible on the beach. The quadruped immediately to the right has a dog-like body, legs and tail in the walking-person context, supporting actual dog. The tiny dark mark in the upper-left sky suggests a flying bird but is too small to establish its anatomy securely, so bird (14) is unclear. Waves and shoreline are not boats or surfboards. No other listed object is supported.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The batter and cropped catcher are actual people. The catcher extends a tan baseball fielding mitt, identifiable by its broad pocket and baseball-catching use; the batter's hand coverings are not additional fielding gloves. The bat, helmet, field markings and shadows do not supply other listed categories. No unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. Multiple actual people ride clearly identifiable horses along the wooded path. A small white dog with darker markings walks at lower left. Riders have visible packs on their backs, with backpack bodies and wearing context; saddle tack and blankets do not establish handbags or other luggage. The trees and undergrowth are unpotted, and no other listed object is identifiable. No unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The plate holds recognizable doughnuts, including the green-iced ring with an exposed bite and the powdered pastry at left, rather than plain bagels or cake. A partially cropped cup sits on a saucer above them, and a spoon has a visible rounded bowl and long handle. The dishes and breakfast setting identify the underlying surface as an eating table. Flat plates and saucers are not bowls; icing colors alone do not establish fruit or vegetables. No unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The dark vertical signal head beside the Webb Way street sign is an actual traffic-light assembly. The higher curved fixture is a street lamp, and the green street-name signs are not stop signs. The small pale fixture atop the lamp does not identify a bird or airplane. No other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The airborne object has a fuselage, wings, engines and landing gear, establishing an actual airplane. Houses, poles and trees below are outside the listed categories. Tiny pale forms cut by the lower border are insufficiently resolved to distinguish boat hulls from portions of road vehicles, so car (2) and boat (8) remain unclear. No other listed category has supported presence.

Inspected the entire original crop and considered each of the 75 frozen definitions. The black animal has feline ears, eyes, face, whiskers and paws, establishing an actual cat. Its forepaws rest on patterned cloth covering an otherwise cropped support. That limited covered support does not let me distinguish chair, sofa or bedding reliably, so chair (56), couch (57) and bed (59) remain unclear. The wall and frame edge do not establish any other listed object.
